text:
The largest regular tetrahedron that can be cut from a 7 × 7 square using a parallelogram net has edge length  

\[
a = \frac{7\sqrt{6}}{3},
\]

so its total surface area is  

\[
\text{Area}=4\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}a^{2}= \sqrt{3}\,a^{2}= \frac{98\sqrt{3}}{3}\approx 56.58.
\]

**ANSWER:** \(\displaystyle \frac{98\sqrt{3}}{3}\)
